text: As a dedicated parent and Registered Nurse for 31 years, I bring a passion for community advocacy, active listening, and care to the Evergreen School District Board. Having guided one child through our district with a second currently enrolled, I am deeply invested in the success of our schools and every student we serve.

Our district faces meaningful challenges, from stabilizing Special Education to ensuring our budget prioritizes classroom needs. Overcoming these obstacles requires open communication, fiscal responsibility, and true collaboration. I am ready to listen to parents, teachers, students, and our community—so we can meet these challenges together.

Board trustees must provide healthy checks and balances while fostering trust and transparency. My priorities are a student-centered focus that directs resources into classrooms and supports Special Education; collaborative leadership partnering closely with parents, staff, and the Evergreen Teachers Association while advocating for our district in Sacramento and Washington DC; and transparent governance ensuring all major decisions are made openly with community input.

My healthcare background taught me that the best decisions happen when every voice is heard. I will champion our students, support our teachers, and listen to our community. I respectfully ask for your vote.

text: My name is Corinna Diener. I was born in San Jose and have been an Evergreen resident since 1992. My three children and two grandchildren attended the Evergreen School District. For nearly 20 years, I served the district in Child Nutrition Services, as a Health Aide, and as a School Secretary, working closely with students, families, and staff to support a safe and positive learning environment. I also served as PTA President and volunteered with local swim and youth soccer programs, giving me firsthand experience in the importance of strong schools, engaged families, and community partnerships.

The Evergreen School District faces important challenges in the years ahead. We need practical leadership that is fiscally responsible while maintaining the high standards our students, staff, and community deserve. By working together with a transparent, collaborative, and unified Board of Trustees, we can make thoughtful decisions that strengthen our schools and build trust throughout our community.
I would be honored to earn your vote so we can continue building a stronger, more supportive educational community for every student. Thank you for your support.

text: As a lifelong educator, former principal, and your current Trustee, I am running for re-election to the Evergreen School Board to provide steady leadership, unmatched experience, and a common-sense approach to serving our schools.

My journey reflects the promise of public education. I came to America as an immigrant who spoke no English. Through hard work, education, and the support of my community, I earned degrees from UCLA and San José State University and have dedicated more than 25 years to serving students and families.

Our schools face complex financial challenges. I am the only candidate on this ballot with proven experience as a teacher, principal, school district Chief Business Official, and your current Trustee. This unique combination of educational leadership, financial expertise, and board governance enables me to make informed decisions, balance budgets responsibly, protect special education services, and ensure resources are focused on student success.

Our community deserves transparent leadership and responsible stewardship. Together, we can retain outstanding teachers, maximize classroom resources, protect student safety, and maintain high academic standards for every child.
Join us at marypollett.com. Together, we can deliver results for the next generation.
